description: This file defines the IMediaKeysClient interface, which is an abstract base class for handling media key events such as license requests, license renewals, and key status changes within the Rialto media framework. It is part of the Rialto project and provides the API for media key client implementations.

classes.name: IMediaKeysClient
classes.description: An interface for handling media key events such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes in Rialto.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Notification callback when a license request is needed, providing session ID, license request message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Notification callback when a license renewal is required, providing session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Notification callback when the status of keys in a session has changed, providing session ID and key status vector.
